name: WASP-140
description: Star of 5,300 K, 118 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

radius.source: Hellier et al. 2017, the stellar radius of WASP-140 b's parameter set from Hellier et al. 2017 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

text.card: WASP-140 b crosses WASP-140 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius follows Hellier et al. 2017, and its temperature Alexoudi 2022.
